# Atlas Obscura
> Definitive guidebook and friendly tour guide to the world’s most wondrous places, with unusual destinations, travel stories, tips, and events.

Atlas Obscura helps curious travelers discover hidden wonders, strange landmarks, cultural oddities, food traditions, and remarkable places around the world through destination entries, editorial features, city guides, trips, and experiences.

## Explore Places
- [Places](https://www.atlasobscura.com/places): Browse Atlas Obscura’s global directory of unusual places, landmarks, and hidden wonders.
- [Map](https://www.atlasobscura.com/map): Interactive map for discovering nearby curiosities and notable places worldwide.
- [Random Place](https://www.atlasobscura.com/random): Jump to a random Atlas Obscura destination for serendipitous exploration.
- [Destinations](https://www.atlasobscura.com/destinations): Explore places grouped by country, region, and city.
- [Lists](https://www.atlasobscura.com/lists): Curated collections of unusual places organized by theme and topic.
- [Itineraries](https://www.atlasobscura.com/itineraries): Multi-stop travel routes built around unusual attractions and regional themes.

## Travel Guides
- [Travel](https://www.atlasobscura.com/travel): Editorial travel hub featuring destination guides, practical advice, and trip inspiration.
- [City Guides](https://www.atlasobscura.com/things-to-do): Find unusual things to do in cities around the world.
- [Where to Wander 2025](https://wheretowander2025.atlasobscura.com/): Annual guide to surprising destinations recommended by Atlas Obscura editors.
- [The United States](https://www.atlasobscura.com/things-to-do/united-states): Unusual attractions, food, and experiences across the United States.
- [New York City](https://www.atlasobscura.com/things-to-do/new-york-city-new-york): Hidden wonders and offbeat things to do in New York City.
- [London](https://www.atlasobscura.com/things-to-do/london-england): Curious places, local stories, and unusual activities in London.

## Stories & Editorial
- [Articles](https://www.atlasobscura.com/articles): Editorial archive of stories on travel, history, science, and culture.
- [Places Articles](https://www.atlasobscura.com/articles/place): Stories centered on destinations, landmarks, and travel discoveries.
- [Food Articles](https://www.atlasobscura.com/articles/food): Reporting on regional dishes, culinary traditions, and food history.
- [History Articles](https://www.atlasobscura.com/articles/history): Features exploring overlooked history, artifacts, and historical mysteries.
- [Science Articles](https://www.atlasobscura.com/articles/science): Stories about natural phenomena, research, and scientific curiosities.
- [Dark Travel Articles](https://www.atlasobscura.com/articles/dark-travel): Coverage of eerie sites, macabre history, and unusual dark destinations.

## Food & Drink
- [Food](https://www.atlasobscura.com/food): Explore culinary traditions, regional specialties, and food-focused travel stories.
- [Unique Restaurants](https://www.atlasobscura.com/things-to-do/categories/unique-restaurants): Discover unusual restaurants and memorable dining destinations.
- [Bars](https://www.atlasobscura.com/things-to-do/categories/bars): Find distinctive bars and drinking spots with unusual character.
- [Bakeries](https://www.atlasobscura.com/things-to-do/categories/bakeries): Browse notable bakeries and specialty pastry destinations.
- [Markets](https://www.atlasobscura.com/things-to-do/categories/markets): Explore markets known for local culture, food, and atmosphere.

## Experiences & Trips
- [Trips](https://www.atlasobscura.com/trips): Small-group journeys and guided travel experiences curated by Atlas Obscura.
- [Experiences](https://www.atlasobscura.com/experiences): Book events, classes, and local experiences focused on curiosity and discovery.
- [Online Experiences](https://www.atlasobscura.com/experiences/online): Virtual events and online classes led by experts and guides.
- [In-Person Experiences](https://www.atlasobscura.com/experiences/in-person): Live local events and hands-on experiences in cities and destinations.
- [Private Trips](https://www.atlasobscura.com/trips/private): Custom private group travel built around Atlas Obscura-style itineraries.

## Community
- [Community](https://www.atlasobscura.com/community): Community hub for participation, contributions, and local exploration.
- [Submit a Place](https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/submit): Contribute a new unusual place to the Atlas Obscura database.
- [Community Forums](https://community.atlasobscura.com/): Discussion space for members sharing recommendations and discoveries.
- [Events Near You](https://www.atlasobscura.com/experiences): Browse upcoming events and experiences by location and format.
- [Atlas Obscura Society](https://www.atlasobscura.com/experiences): Membership-oriented experiences and community programming.

## Courses & Learning
- [Courses](https://courses.atlasobscura.com/courses): Catalog of online courses on history, culture, nature, and travel topics.
- [Atlas Obscura Courses](https://courses.atlasobscura.com/): Learning platform for expert-led online classes and educational series.
- [Gift Courses](https://courses.atlasobscura.com/collections): Browse course collections suitable for gifting and themed learning.

## Books & Shop
- [Books](https://www.atlasobscura.com/books): Atlas Obscura books and publications inspired by hidden wonders and travel.
- [Shop](https://shop.atlasobscura.com/): Official store for books, gifts, and Atlas Obscura merchandise.
- [Atlas Obscura Book](https://www.atlasobscura.com/books/atlas-obscura): Flagship book featuring remarkable places around the world.
- [Gastro Obscura Book](https://www.atlasobscura.com/books/gastro-obscura): Food-focused book exploring culinary wonders and traditions.
